//: Justification manifest for every pnpm override in pnpm-workspace.yaml. This is the single source of truth: scripts/__tests__/pnpm-workspace-config.test.mjs enforces a 1:1 mapping (every override has an entry here and vice-versa) and that each `override` value matches the pin in pnpm-workspace.yaml. Adding an override without a dated, CVE-annotated entry here fails CI. category A = the declaring parent forbids the fixed version (out-of-range force); category B = the fix is in-range but pnpm resolves a vulnerable version without the pin (an override is pnpm's only lever to bump a deep transitive). Remove an entry when its parent ships a release carrying the fix — test by deleting the pin, installing, and confirming `osv-scanner` shows no regression. See docs/internal/dependency-overrides.md.

yaml-language-server>yaml.reason: yaml parser DoS. yaml-language-server hard-pins yaml 2.7.1; the override forces past that exact pin.

gray-matter>js-yaml.reason: js-yaml merge-key quadratic DoS, no patched 3.x. gray-matter declares ^3.x; paired with patchedDependencies gray-matter@4.0.3 (safeLoad/safeDump -> load/dump).

read-yaml-file>js-yaml.reason: js-yaml merge-key quadratic DoS, no patched 3.x. read-yaml-file declares ^3.x; paired with patchedDependencies read-yaml-file@1.1.0 (safeLoad/safeDump -> load/dump).

@istanbuljs/load-nyc-config>js-yaml.reason: js-yaml merge-key quadratic DoS, no patched 3.x. @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config declares ^3.x but already uses load(), so it needs only the override (no patch).

qs.reason: qs stringify DoS. Without the pin, resolution picks the vulnerable 6.15.1 (proven by removal -> OSV regression on 2026-07-23). Reaches production via packages/mcp -> express -> qs.

hono.reason: hono XSS/JSX context/gateway-drop. Reaches production via packages/mcp -> @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (declares ^4.11.4, so in-range) but pnpm will not bump the transitive without the pin. Drop when the SDK ships a release resolving hono >= 4.12.27.

express>body-parser.reason: body-parser DoS on invalid limit. Reaches production via packages/mcp -> express (declares ^2.2.1, so in-range) but pnpm will not bump the transitive without the pin.

brace-expansion@5.reason: brace-expansion 5.x exponential-time expansion DoS. Version-scoped to the 5.x line only so the 1.x/2.x copies (already patched) are untouched. Dev tooling (minimatch via eslint/stryker).

npm-run-all2>shell-quote.reason: shell-quote quadratic-complexity parse DoS (vulnerable <= 1.8.4). Scoped to the sole vulnerable consumer, the dev tool npm-run-all2 (declares ^1.8.4). NOT a blanket pin: packages/cli and packages/core declare shell-quote ^1.10.0 directly and must keep resolving to >= 1.10.0 — a blanket ^1.9.0 downgraded them.

fast-uri.reason: fast-uri host confusion via IDN/backslash. 3.1.4 fixes both on the 3.x line; ajv declares ^3.0.1, so in-range, but pnpm will not bump the transitive without the pin. Dev tooling (ajv via @astrojs/check, stryker).
